parts.title: Today’s words
parts.uz: Bugungi so’zlar: inglizcha so’z va tarjimasi

parts.title: I like… I don’t like…: circle the right one
items: Menga sut yoqmaydi. = I {don’t like|like} milk.
Men palovni yaxshi ko’raman. = I {like|don’t like} plov.
I like tea. — I like tea, {too|to}.

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {are|is} two apples on the table.

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences: 2 with “I like” and 2 with “I don’t like”.
items.hint: Example: I like plov. I like green tea. I don’t like fish. I don’t like coffee.
